review_text: Terrible service I have had problems loading money by Visa card a few times - the money goes from my bank but doesn't show in esewa. They all want you to call later, so that someone else can deal with the problem and not them. Once the 13,000 rupees that are currently missing have been returned, I'll be deleting.
